cold.source: ERA5-Land via the Open-Meteo archive (era5_seamless, 1991-2020 record low), lapse-adjusted to Copernicus DEM GLO-90

frost_free.source: ERA5-Land via the Open-Meteo archive (era5_seamless, 1991-2020 median frost-free days)

frost_free_station_bias.source: NOAA NCEI U.S. Climate Normals 1991-2020 station growing season, against the station cell

precipitation.source: PRISM Group, Oregon State University: 1991-2020 annual precipitation normal, 800 m, area-averaged to the cell; dry year = that normal times ERA5's 20th-percentile-to-mean ratio (Open-Meteo era5_seamless)

soil_ph_texture.source: USDA NRCS SSURGO dominant component where present, else ISRIC SoilGrids v2.0 0-30 cm

soil_survey.source: USDA NRCS SSURGO via Soil Data Access: dominant component, 0-30 cm; MLRA by SDA lookup
